display.purpose: The Koto-Koto wordmark and the result screen's grade letter.

heading.purpose: Page-level titles such as "Records" or "About Koto-Koto".

body.purpose: Paragraph copy on About/Privacy/Terms/Licenses; falls back to the OS sans-serif stack since no Inter font file is loaded.

label.purpose: Short uppercase micro-labels: tabs, field labels, stat captions.

numeric.purpose: WPM/Zen Score/keystroke figures where digit alignment matters.

shadows.name: seasonal-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient halo behind headings, the timer, and the active grade letter; brightness follows the time of day.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--season-primary) 27%, transparent), 0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb, var(--season-glow) 15%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Structural depth on a focused input, replacing the default browser focus ring.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Separates the settings dropdown and toasts from the page behind them; paired with backdrop-blur-xl.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Universal instant press feedback on every clickable element; never a color-only hover.

motion.name: panel-spring
motion.purpose: Settings menu and other floating panels open/close anchored to their trigger.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Seasonal/time-of-day palette changes cross-fade over 1s instead of cutting.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: Main call-to-action pill (auth submit, share/replay actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: #efefef; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'Zen Old Mincho', serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Chip Button
components.description: Small bordered secondary action, e.g. ending an endless session.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: rgba(239,239,239,0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Zen Old Mincho', serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #efefef; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Circular icon-only header action (history, leaderboard, profile, settings).
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; color: #d4d4d8; background: transparent; border: none; transition: color 0.2s ease-out, background-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: #efefef; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.90); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pill-shaped mode picker, e.g. Classic vs Word Endless.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px; } .ds-segmented-item { border: none; background: transparent; color: rgba(239,239,239,0.6); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.3s, color 0.3s, transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-segmented-item:hover { color: rgba(239,239,239,0.85); } .ds-segmented-item.is-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: #efefef; } .ds-segmented-item:active { transform: scale(0.90); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Result-screen and rankings metric tile (WPM, Accuracy, Zen Score); border tints with the active season.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.19); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #d4d4d8; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 300; color: #efefef; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Auth form input; border and caret switch to the active season's primary color on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #efefef; font-family: 'Zen Old Mincho', serif; font-size: 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03); transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #fb923c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(251,146,60,0.27), 0 0 22px rgba(251,146,60,0.045); }

narrative.overview:
Koto-Koto is a Japanese typing game staged as a quiet, dark room that changes light with the season (花鳥風月 — flower, bird, wind, moon) and the hour (移ろい — passing time). The interface itself stays deliberately plain: a nearly-black stage, one serif wordmark, and glassy translucent panels. All of the system's expressiveness is spent on a single channel — a seasonal accent color that tints glows, borders, and particles — rather than on layout novelty or decorative chrome. The effect is closer to a lantern in a dark room than a dashboard: the room doesn't change shape, only its light does.

Motion follows the same restraint: interactive elements answer a press with an instant, small scale-down (no bounce, no overshoot), and larger surfaces (the settings panel, toasts) enter with a short critically-damped spring rather than a linear fade. prefers-reduced-motion drops every looping/ambient animation (particles, pulses, carets) while keeping the state cues that carry meaning.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral, near-black material (translucent white on #1a1a1a) carries every screen; color is reserved for the seasonal accent
Every season x time-of-day combination is a first-class palette, not a filter over one base theme
Zen Old Mincho is the only voice for headings, labels, and the wordmark — there is no separate UI sans-serif in active use
Pill shapes (rounded-full) for anything clickable; rounded rectangles only for containers
Depth comes from blur + translucency (glass), not from drop shadows

rules.name: The Tinted Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces themselves stay neutral (bg-white/5–bg-white/10 glass on #1a1a1a); the seasonal accent shows up only as a border tint ({primary}30, ~19% alpha), a glow (box-shadow/text-shadow using the season's glow rgba), or a small indicator dot — never as a large fill.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Off-white is the only text/icon color anywhere in the app; hierarchy is built with opacity (/60, /85) and size, not with a second neutral gray-on-gray scale.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label goes below 11px, even in the game's smallest micro-labels.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: uppercase is only applied to labels short enough to read as a shape, not a sentence — never to a full clause or sentence of copy.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows in this system color and warm an element; they don't lift it. Reach for backdrop-blur + translucency to imply a surface, and the seasonal glow to imply attention — not a gray drop shadow.

rules.name: The Round-If-Clickable Rule
rules.body: If it's a button/tab/chip, it's rounded-full. If it's a card, panel, or input, it's a rounded rectangle. The two languages never swap roles.

dos: Do drive every color decision through the season x time-of-day palette (useThemePalette) rather than hardcoding a hex for a "seasonal" element.
Do keep functional/label text at 11px or larger; use text-xs/text-sm for anything a user reads as a sentence.
Do give every clickable element the instant :active scale-down; a control that only reacts on :hover reads as unfinished in this system.

Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (drop loops/parallax, keep state-carrying opacity/color changes) and prefers-reduced-transparency (drop backdrop-blur, keep the underlying color) for any new animated or glassy element.
donts: Don't introduce a second neutral gray scale; off-white + opacity is the only text-hierarchy tool.
Don't fill a large surface with a saturated seasonal color — the accent is a border/glow/indicator color, not a background color.
Don't set uppercase on anything longer than a short label; it removes word-shape and hurts readability on full sentences.
Don't reach for a gray box-shadow to lift a card; use blur + translucency for surface, and the seasonal glow for emphasis.
